question: Does a longitudinal hypergraph coupling field learned from seven complete patients predict patient-disjoint RNA-protein dependence across treatment time better than a tuned classical time-conditioned Poisson interaction, independence, destroyed links, and a retuned graph-zero exact-coupling ablation?
assay: PBMC CITE-seq during pembrolizumab plus GM-CSF treatment for advanced biliary cancer

split.complete_patient_rule: Sort all 15 patients with T01-T04 by SHA256('GSE317605-PATIENT-SPLIT-v1|COMPLETE|<canonical integer patient id>'), then assign the first seven to calibration, next three to pilot, and final five to held.
split.partial_patient_rule: Append the three remaining eligible patients to held in ascending integer patient order; do not use partial patients in model selection or fitting.

cell_contract.technical_replicates: Pool technical replicates within the same physical patient and timepoint. A cell is identified by replicate, one-based deposited Matrix Market column, and deposited barcode string; duplicate barcode strings are permitted and remain distinct by column.
cell_contract.cell_identity: (<replicate>, <one-based deposited Matrix Market column>, <deposited barcode string>)
cell_contract.rna_state: one if selected-cell UMI count is positive, zero otherwise
cell_contract.adt_state: For each patient, timepoint, and ADT marker, rank selected cells by descending count and then ascending SHA256('GSE317605-ADT-TIE-v2\0<patient>\0<timepoint>\0<ADT marker>\0<replicate>\0<one-based column>\0<barcode>'); label the first 96 high.

feature_axes.coordinate_convention: one-based deposited Matrix Market row index

estimators.primary: time-conditioned exact fixed-margin coupling field with donor-timepoint deviations, a fixed biological product-hypergraph penalty, temporal path smoothing, and a frozen transport multiplier

fixed_marker_hypergraph.marker_operator: L_H = I - D_v^(-1/2) H W D_e^(-1) H^T D_v^(-1/2), with unit W
fixed_marker_hypergraph.ordered_pair_operator: L_pair = L_H tensor I + I tensor L_H

estimators.objective: For each timepoint, average over its training visits the sum across ordered marker pairs of exact fixed-margin conditional negative log likelihood at beta[time,pair] + u[visit,pair] plus (eta/2) times the squared visit-deviation norm; then sum those four timepoint means. Add unscaled penalties (0.01/2) times the squared beta norm, (gamma/2) times sum_t beta_t^T L_pair beta_t, and (tau/2) times sum_t ||beta_(t+1)-beta_t||^2. Thus conditional likelihood and deviation ridge receive the same inverse visit count within each timepoint; all beta penalties are unscaled.
estimators.graph_zero_definition: Set the marker hypergraph penalty to zero and reselect temporal, deviation, and transport values on the identical source-only folds.

non_gating_sensitivities.temporal_zero_retuned_exact_coupling: Set the temporal penalty to zero and reselect marker, deviation, and transport values on the identical source-only folds.
non_gating_sensitivities.structure_zero_exact_coupling: Set both marker and temporal penalties to zero and reselect deviation and transport values on the identical source-only folds.
non_gating_sensitivities.poisson_interaction_conditional_reconstr: Take the interaction coefficients selected by the tuned classical Poisson baseline and reconstruct each target table by the exact fixed-margin conditional expectation instead of classical Poisson reconstruction.

estimators.poisson_selection: Cross the four Poisson ridge values with all five transport multipliers on the identical leave-one-physical-patient-out folds.
estimators.selection_tie_break: Compare the exact patient-equal cross-validation means without tolerance. On equality choose the ascending lexicographically smallest full frozen tuple: (deviation, hypergraph, temporal, transport) for every exact-coupling selection, including restricted sensitivities, and (Poisson ridge, transport) for the classical Poisson baseline. The destroyed-link control uses the selected primary tuple and is not selected separately.

calibration.evaluation: leave-one-physical-patient-out across seven complete calibration patients

held.bootstrap_enumeration: Exhaust all 5^5 ordered complete-patient resamples and all 3^3 ordered partial-patient resamples with replacement, then take their Cartesian product; no random seed is used.
held.bootstrap_gate_estimand: paired additive patient-equal mean loss difference, primary minus comparator
reported_bootstrap_estimands: paired relative loss reduction, (comparator minus primary) divided by comparator
held.bootstrap_interval: two-sided 95% empirical percentile interval using type-7 linear quantiles over all 84,375 resamples

prohibitions: read any pilot ADT matrix before public pilot GEX predictions
read any held GEX matrix before a passing public pilot result
read any held ADT matrix before public held GEX predictions
write a raw cell identifier or cell-level state vector to a public artifact
change the split, markers, state rules, grids, gates, seeds, comparator set, or outcome after count access

preregistration.mechanism: annotated public git tags before the first count-matrix request
